lead.t: The fibula is lateral to the tibia, ossifies from three centres (not five), does provide some origin for flexor digitorum longus, and soleus arises from the upper (not lower) fibula.
lead.s: Anatomy Must-Know — Lower Limb MCQs, Section 3 (Part 3 of 4)
